title: L\'evy Attention: Single-Pass Predictive Uncertainty for Continuous-Time Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.19171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep models for irregularly-sampled time series answer queries at arbitrary continuous timestamps, yet report nothing about how far each answer should be trusted. We show the attention layer itself can close that gap: with the right stochastic formulation, the pass that makes each prediction also reports, in closed form and at no extra cost, how far it should be trusted. We introduce L\'evy Attention, a cross-attention operator whose output is a stochastic integral against an inhomogeneous Poisson random measure: query-key compatibilities assemble an intensity over a continuous (time x channel) index space, the measure scatters atoms under it, and the output averages an interpolated value field at those atoms. In expectation it reduces to a mollified cosine-kernel attention, so it replaces a softmax layer and trains with exact gradients.   What softmax discards, the Poisson construction preserves in closed form: the evidence $\Lambda_q$

translated_title: Lévy注意力：连续时间注意力的单次前向预测不确定性
translated_abstract: 针对不规则采样时间序列的深度模型能在任意连续时间戳上回答查询，但未报告每个答案应被信任的程度。我们表明注意力层本身可以弥合这一差距：通过正确的随机公式化，每次预测的前向传递还能以封闭形式且无需额外成本报告其应受信任的程度。我们引入了Lévy注意力，一种交叉注意力算子，其输出是对非齐次泊松随机测度的随机积分：查询-键兼容性在连续（时间×通道）索引空间上组装强度，测度在其下散布原子，输出在这些原子处对插值值场进行平均。在期望上，它简化为一个平滑化的余弦核注意力，因此能替代softmax层并以精确梯度训练。softmax丢弃的内容，泊松构造以封闭形式保留：证据Λ_q
tldr: Lévy注意力通过泊松随机测度在连续时间注意力中实现了单次前向传递的预测不确定性估计，以封闭形式提供信任度且无需额外计算成本。
en_tdlr: Lévy attention enables single-pass predictive uncertainty estimation for continuous-time attention via Poisson random measures, providing closed-form trust scores at no extra computational cost.
